svg.text: MEA analysis pipeline — components, files and hardware
benshalom-labtower1. Orchestration-MEA drives MEA-Analysis as a subprocess and never modifies it; raw data is never written to.
Run page: wells, NWB steps, time
job.json: input and output folders, skip_spikesorting = true (default), nwb_convert = false (default), staging, concurrency, AI requirements
Refuses any output / scratch / checkpoint folder inside the input folder — the raw data is read-only
Phase 1 · Preprocessing: read .h5 (MaxWell plugin) or .nwb → filter + common reference →
float32 binary scratch copy; 16 CPU workers. Checkpoint saved after each stage.
Data rules: the raw-data folders are never written; other users' folders and processes are never touched; SSD scratch exists only while a job runs.
